compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
Nine storage-maintenance spellings (`fsck`, `fsck-recover`, `doctor`, `tracker-maintenance`, `tracker-footprint`, `export`, `import`, `compact`, `compact-all`) sit at top level with a redundant `tracker-` prefix and a `compact`/`compact-all` pair. They carry four different init policies, so the group cannot be one route with one `init`. Operator decision: hard cutover into `rebar store <sub>` with removed-name hints (the hint registry landed in story trivial-americium-motmot). Cites are on origin/main c0cf1022671 (re-verified 2026-10-19); call-site inventories are in this ticket's 2026-10-19 comment.

## Approach
(1) `src/rebar/_cli/_registry.py`: new public `STORE_ROUTES: tuple[Route, ...]` (in `__all__`), members `fsck fsck-recover doctor maintenance footprint export import compact`, `group="store"`, each keeping its current `parser_factory`, `handler`, `adapter`, `init`, `no_auto_mount`; `compact` gets handler `rebar._commands.compact:compact_dispatch_cli` and the help-facing factory `core.compact:build_compact`. One top-level `Route("store", group="store", parser_factory="rebar._cli._parsers.advanced.store:build", handler="rebar._cli._store_commands:store_cli", adapter="argv", init="none")`. Delete the 9 top-level routes: `compact`/`compact-all`/`export`/`import` (`:210-249` in `_simple_read_groups()`, leaving `reclaim-collapse` `:226-233`), `fsck`/`fsck-recover`/`tracker-maintenance`/`doctor` (`:457-488` in `_bridge_and_arms()`), and the `tracker-footprint` block `:393-404` (the only edit inside `_intercepts()`; the overlap epic that owned it is closed). Drop `compact`/`io` from `_GROUP_TO_SET` (`:46,48`).
(2) `_execute.execute(name, rest, *, routes=ROUTES)` (`_execute.py:29-31`) passes `routes` to `route_for`.
(3) New `src/rebar/_cli/_store_commands.py`: no sub prints usage to stderr, exit 2; an unknown sub gets argparse invalid-choice from the store parser, exit 2; `wants_help(rest)` prints `factory(prog=f"rebar store {sub}").format_help()` (usage capitalized as `scripts/gen_cli_help.py` does) and exits 0; otherwise `_execute.execute(sub, rest, routes=STORE_ROUTES)`, so each member applies its own init policy.
(4) New `src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/advanced/store.py`, modelled on `advanced/audit.py`: 8 subparsers whose help line is the first line of the member factory's description.
(5) `_help_route._NESTED_INTERCEPTS` (`:21-23`) gains `"store"`; `_cli/__init__.py:_store_mount_eligible` (`:28-44`) returns False for `store <sub>` when that member has `no_auto_mount` (derived from `STORE_ROUTES`, so `footprint` keeps the no-mount behaviour pinned at `tests/unit/test_cli_registry.py:108-116`).
(6) `_cli/_parsers/core/compact.py`: rename `build_compact` (`:19`) to `build_compact_one`; new help-facing `build_compact` = the one-ticket flags plus `--all` plus the sweep flags marked "(with --all)"; keep `build_compact_all` (`:37`). `_commands/compact.py`: new `compact_dispatch_cli(argv)`: `--all` before `--` delegates to `compact_all_cli(argv without --all)`; `--dry-run`/`--limit`/`--include-archived` without `--all` exits 2; else `compact_cli(argv)`, which parses with `build_compact_one`. Prog strings `:116`/`:533` become `rebar store compact`/`rebar store compact --all`; library callers of `compact_cli`/`compact_all_cli` are unchanged.
(7) `_help_route._REMOVED_SPELLINGS` gains the 9 entries (`compact-all` -> `rebar store compact --all`, `tracker-maintenance` -> `rebar store maintenance`, `tracker-footprint` -> `rebar store footprint`, the rest `rebar store <same>`).
(8) `.github/workflows/compact-sweep.yml:153` runs `rebar store compact --all` (`pip install -e .` at `:85` makes the same-change edit atomic); comments at `compact-sweep.yml:90` and `reconcile-bridge.yml:107` follow.
(9) In-source user-facing strings naming the 9 spellings (84 hits in 42 `src/rebar` files: prog, usage, error and hint strings, docstrings, 5 schema descriptions) become the new spellings. The census regex also matched `from rebar import`, which is excluded.
(10) Teaching surfaces outside frozen history (`docs/**` except `archive/`, `experiments/`, `adr/`, `release-notes.md`; `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `src/rebar/_guides/`, `examples/mcp-clients/`) use the new spellings, so the docs story keeps only release notes, CHANGELOG and ADR 0117. `docs/exit-codes.md`: the per-verb rows become `store <sub>` rows plus one `store` row, and the removed-verbs paragraph lists the 9.
(11) Regenerate help (9 artifacts deleted, `help/store.txt` added) and `docs/cli-reference.md`.
(12) Tests and scripts CI runs: every CI-run invocation of an old spelling retargets (inventory comment and its corrections: `scripts/probe_rebar.py` and 22 test files, including the integration-tier `test_concurrency_regression.py` and `test_store_concurrency.py`), as does every test asserting a reworded message. `test_cli_registry.py`: `_CENSUS_SETS` drops `_COMPACT`/`_IO`, `_INDIVIDUAL_ARMS` swaps the 4 repair arms for `store`, the no-mount test moves to the `footprint` member. `test_cli_registry_dispatch.py`: the init census and init-spy tests run members through `routes=STORE_ROUTES`. `test_core_cli_parsers.py`: its census covers the store members. `test_schema_coverage.py`: drives `store fsck|doctor|footprint` and lists them beside `audit` as output advertisers absent from top-level help.

## Scope
`src/rebar/_cli/{_registry,_execute,_help_route,__init__}.py`, `src/rebar/_cli/_store_commands.py` (new), `src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/advanced/store.py` (new), `src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/core/compact.py`, `src/rebar/_commands/compact.py`, the in-source string files of step (9), `.github/workflows/{compact-sweep,reconcile-bridge}.yml`, help and reference, the step (10) docs, tests and scripts. Out of scope: `reclaim-collapse`, `scratch`, `delete`; library and MCP names (`rebar.fsck`, the MCP `fsck` tool, `OUTPUT_SCHEMAS` keys) stay unchanged.

## Testing
Each old spelling: `rebar <old>` exits 2 with the hint (parametrized from `_REMOVED_SPELLINGS`). `rebar store` exits 2 with usage; `rebar store bogus` exits 2; `rebar store --help` equals committed `help/store.txt`; `rebar store fsck --help` equals `build_fsck(prog="rebar store fsck")` help, exit 0. Init spy per member; `store footprint` skips the central mount (`test_central_mount_gate_ad9f`). `store compact <id> --dry-run` exits 2; `store compact --all --dry-run` bytes equal the old `compact-all --dry-run`. Existing `fsck`/`doctor`/`export`/`footprint` JSON goldens retargeted. Before/after greps pasted into a comment; `check_complexity_baseline.py --check`; both generators `--check`; the touched integration-tier files; `make verify`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `route_for(x) is None` for the 9 old spellings and `main([x])` exits 2 with the hint (parametrized test).
- [ ] `validate(STORE_ROUTES) == ()`, member names are unique, and every member's handler and factory resolve.
- [ ] `rebar store` and `rebar store bogus` exit 2; `rebar store --help` equals `help/store.txt`; `rebar store fsck --help` equals `build_fsck(prog="rebar store fsck")` help with exit 0.
- [ ] Each member runs under its own init policy, asserted per member with the init spy, and `store footprint` skips the central mount.
- [ ] `store compact <id> --dry-run` exits 2, and `store compact --all --dry-run` output equals the old `compact-all --dry-run`.
- [ ] `compact-sweep.yml` invokes `rebar store compact --all`; `gen_cli_help.py --check`, `gen_cli_reference.py --check`, the exit-code doc tests and `scripts/probe_rebar.py` pass.
- [ ] JSON output of every member is byte-identical to its pre-move golden.
- [ ] A grep for `rebar <old spelling>` over `src/rebar tests scripts .github` and the step (10) docs prints only the removed-spelling registry, its tests, and frozen history.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0 with `PYPANDOC_PANDOC` set to pandoc 3.9, and the touched integration-tier files pass.
